0022600001.text: Both the Boston Celtics and the Detroit Pistons are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Celtics on the road in Detroit. Boston enters with eight players listed as day-to-day and unavailable due to rest, all with game-time decisions: Derrick White, Jayson Tatum, Mike Conley, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Paul George, Payton Pritchard and Sam Hauser. In 2025-26 the Celtics lost 1-3 to Detroit, and their most recent meeting, on January 19, 2026 in Detroit, ended in a 104-103 Celtics loss, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Boston a 50% chance to win.
